description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entity, including custom query methods for retrieving and calculating amortization allocation data related to loans.

classes.name: LoanAmortizationAllocationMappingRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entity, providing data access methods including custom queries.

methods.name: findAmortizationMappingsByBaseTransactionAndLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a list of AmortizationAllocationMappingDTO objects for a given base loan transaction ID and loan ID.

methods.name: calculateAlreadyAmortizedAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total already amortized amount for a specific base loan transaction ID and loan ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionAllocationByAmortizationLoanTransactionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping entities based on amortization loan transaction ID and loan ID.
